highlights: A brand-new theme picker: choose from built-in themes, community themes, or your own saved looks, all in one place.
Community themes — browse looks shared by other students, like your favourites, and share your own creations.
Automatic light & dark: let Better Intra follow the sunrise and sunset at your campus.
Exact numbers — your wallet, rank, and score now show the precise value instead of a rounded 2.0k.
More fonts, organized in a dedicated Fonts card, with a percentage size slider.
Quality of life: clearer confirmation dialogs, clickable theme authors, and a tidier logtime tracker.
A new Account tab: manage your cloud account, list your devices, and revoke sessions.
Cloud backups with a three-way merge and a conflict review screen, plus manual or automatic push.
A first-run welcome screen with a guided tour and font selection.
Logtime streaks with a chip, popover, and date ranges.
Faster Students browsing with server-side pagination and wallet/evaluation badges.
New Seishin and Twilight themes, plus a guided tour for the cluster map.
Faster startup — the extension does less background work and shares its styles more efficiently.
Smoother profiles, marks, and project badges that stay in sync after the page re-renders.
Smaller, more reliable hover tooltips.
A reorganized settings window with an Appearance tab and a search bar to find any option quickly.
A multi-year calendar for piscine students.
Theme sharing, custom fonts applied across the whole site, and a V2 blackhole countdown mode.
A polished About page with community stats and a growth chart.
Cluster maps for every 42 campus — see seat occupancy and who is online right now.
A new Students browser with filters, sorting, and one-click login copying.
Piscine navigation cards, an announcement banner, and campus timezones.
Friends widget improvements and richer tooltips across the extension.
A full Students dialog with sorting, filtering, and detailed badges.
A star total badge in the marks section.
Redesigned logtime buttons and project sort controls that follow your theme.
Full historical logtime with compact and heatmap calendar views.
A tracker card with mode selection and live progress.
A styled personal info card with campus flags and a custom nav-bar avatar.
Drag-to-reorder hub settings, cluster map zoom, and GitHub star/follower counts.
The Friends feature: a floating button with medals and custom avatars.
Automatic campus detection and per-campus cluster configuration.
New light themes (Soap, Citrus, Neon) alongside the dark ones.
Cloud sync with auto-push, plus export, import, and reset for your settings.
Calendar sync: subscribe to your 42 events through an ICS link, with a scannable QR code.
Project badges and detailed evaluation stats.
Your subscribed events now appear inside the logtime calendar.
13 profile themes to make the intranet yours.
A redesigned Discord settings panel and a cleaner bar under your level.
Click your money badge to open the shop, and an option to disable the new info card.
Freeze info, a custom achievements card, and a pending evaluations card.
Discord connect with OAuth2, plus evaluation notifications.
Marks sorting and caching for themes and profile visuals.
A Friends menu to track your friends' levels and activity.
An account settings menu in the sidebar.
Pool-month badges on profiles.
The first public release of Better Intra.
Dark mode for the whole intranet, an About panel, and cloud sync.
Logtime, clusters, shortcuts, and profile customization from day one.
